answer: Resist sybils with burned unique-asset identity: each agent must burn one distinct scarce digital asset — a domain name or NFT no one else holds — to register, the burn provably recorded on-chain. A cedar-strong registry tracks every burned asset, so one asset can anchor only one identity, like a karst cave with a single entrance. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must buy ten thousand distinct assets at market prices, each burn a shale-hard sunk cost, while an honest agent burns one asset once and keeps its standing.
